trend: Plan of Action: the Combo ritual replaces the supplement shelf
why: Combo messaging from the Plan of Action (one for morning, one for night). It's one of the day's 2 product posts.
text:
Count the jars on your supplement shelf. Now count how many you actually took this week.

We built SILT as two sticks instead: Mornings for energy, gut and vitamins, Nights for sleep and recovery. Sixty seconds, twice a day. The best supplement is the one you don't skip.
